title: Tax treatment for payments made under the Horizon Family Members Redress Scheme
text:
This measure makes sure that compensation payments made under the scheme are not subject to:

 • Income Tax

 • Capital Gains Tax

 • National Insurance contributions

 This measure makes sure that compensation payments made under the scheme are relieved from Inheritance Tax.

 Eligible individuals will receive the full value of their compensation payment without any deductions.
